ORIGINAL USMLE-STYLE PRACTICE

A neurological change over time

At 09:00 an unsedated patient is E4 V5 M6. At 09:30 he opens his eyes only when addressed, uses isolated intelligible words without conversation, and still obeys commands. No new local limitation is present. Which record correctly documents the later examination?

  1. E3 V4 M6 = 13
  2. E2 V3 M6 = 11
  3. E4 V3 M6 = 13
  4. E3 V2 M5 = 10
  5. E3 V3 M6 = 12
Answer and explanation

E3 V3 M6 = 12

Sound-evoked opening and isolated words score E3 and V3; command following remains M6.

Option explanations

E3 V3 M6 = 12: Sound-evoked opening and isolated words score E3 and V3; command following remains M6.

E3 V4 M6 = 13: V4 requires coherent communication despite disorientation.

E2 V3 M6 = 11: The eyes open to sound, not only to pressure.

E4 V3 M6 = 13: The eye response is no longer spontaneous.

E3 V2 M5 = 10: Intelligible words are V3, and obeying commands is M6.
